resumeText:
Rohan Kulkarni | Pune | rohan.kulkarni@example.com | +91 98220 11223

EDUCATION
B.Tech Computer Science (AI & ML), Vishwakarma Institute of Technology, Pune, 2022 - 2026, CGPA 8.4/10

INTERNSHIPS
AI Intern, Saarthi Data Labs, Pune (May 2025 - July 2025, 10 weeks)
- Built a document question-answering chatbot over HR policy PDFs using the OpenAI API and LangChain.
- Chunked 300 PDFs and stored embeddings in a Chroma vector database for semantic retrieval.
- Exposed the chatbot through a FastAPI REST endpoint used by the internal HR portal.

PROJECTS
- Lecture Notes Assistant: wrote a Python pipeline that transcribes lecture audio with Whisper and summarises it with an LLM.
- Resume Screener: ranked 500 sample resumes against a job description using sentence-transformer embeddings and FAISS similarity search.
- Sentiment classifier for Marathi movie reviews using a fine-tuned BERT model (final-year mini project).

COURSEWORK AND CERTIFICATIONS
Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing, Database Systems
DeepLearning.AI - Generative AI with Large Language Models (Coursera, 2025)

SKILLS
Python, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face, FAISS, ChromaDB, FastAPI, Docker, AWS (basics), Git, SQL

ACTIVITIES
Core member, VIT AI Club; organised a 24-hour GenAI hackathon with 200 participants.
